description: This file declares an interface for managing OCI containers within the WPEFramework, including functionalities for container lifecycle management, state notifications, and configuration.

classes.name: IOCIContainer
classes.description: An interface for controlling and querying OCI container states and actions, including starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and other management operations within the container ecosystem.

classes.name: IOCIContainer::INotification
classes.description: A notification interface for container events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for container events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Provides a list of all containers.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container from a bundle.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification JSON.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a specific container, optionally forcefully.

methods.name: PauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a container.

methods.name: ResumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: HibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container with options.

methods.name: WakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Updates container properties with key-value pair.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Removes a specific annotation/key from the container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts a path inside the container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a path inside the container.

methods.name: void OnContainerFailed(const string & containerId,const string & name,uint32_t error)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnContainerStarted(const string & containerId,const string & name)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnContainerStateChanged(const string & containerId,ContainerState state)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnContainerStopped(const string & containerId,const string & name)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown$/

ctags.name: OnContainerFailed
ctags.pattern: /^        virtual void OnContainerFailed(const string& containerId, const string& name, uint32_t e/

ctags.name: OnContainerStarted
ctags.pattern: /^        virtual void OnContainerStarted(const string& containerId, const string& name) {}$/

ctags.name: OnContainerStateChanged
ctags.pattern: /^        virtual void OnContainerStateChanged(const string& containerId, ContainerState state) {}$/

ctags.name: OnContainerStopped
ctags.pattern: /^        virtual void OnContainerStopped(const string& containerId, const string& name) {}$/
